topic: Can the filter's suppression of 19th harmonics improve transponder power efficiency in dense payload configurations?
consensus_response: Suppressing the 19th harmonic reduces intermodulation products and adjacent channel interference, enhancing transponder power efficiency. Filter optimization balances harmonic suppression, group delay, and phase noise to maintain signal integrity and spectral purity, ensuring efficient power allocation and high spectral efficiency in dense payload configurations.
reference_context: Satellite communications face challenges from nonlinear distortions and intermodulation products, affecting power efficiency and spectral purity.
